tlo.bio: Toronto turntablist, producer and touring DJ TLO is a Canadian hip-hop figure who won the Canadian DMC Supremacy title, represented Canada at the DMC World Finals and became Shad's longtime DJ.

william dinero.bio: Toronto recording artist and producer William Dinero, born William Grajeda, makes hip-hop, R&B, Latin and crossover production alongside soundtrack work for film and television.

zayo.bio: Zayo is a Québec rapper whose French-language catalogue sits within contemporary rap québécois, pairing direct street-rap writing with melodic modern production.
